_note: Golden comparison against the Titles pack («Подпись_спикеров», canvas 1500x500 at UHD scale). The 4K variant is rendered with the pack's texts and the canvas window is registered on the first gate frame (sub-pixel). The master keeps the pack timing up to 4.40 s and starts its exit 0.48 s later so it ends on the last frame. gate = static frames (hold 1.52–4.28 s in the pack); view = moving frames (motion blur in the pack, none in the master, C35).
